text: On 24 November 2026 the GB power system recorded a wind mean output of 15871 MW, ranging from a minimum of 11710 MW to a maximum of 18988 MW. Compared with the previous seven days the wind output was 106.9% higher than the mean of 7671 MW. Day‑ahead wind forecasts had a mean absolute error of 937 MW, far below the baseline error of 11315 MW. Demand averaged 35051 MW with a peak of 42901 MW and was 6.5% higher than the prior week’s mean of 32927 MW. The demand forecast MAE was 1621 MW versus a baseline of 2793 MW and the forecast MAPE was 4.83%. Electricity price averaged 199.4 GBP/MWh, between a low of 166.8 GBP/MWh and a high of 227.3 GBP/MWh, 6.9% above the previous week’s mean of 186.5 GBP/MWh. Data quality checks covered 29 series, with 25 passing, 2 warnings and 2 failures; issues included wind_onshore: FAIL, wind_offshore: FAIL, price_apx: WARN and price_n2ex: WARN.
